key_provisions_or_claims: Sets six strategic priorities for 2026-2030, including literacy/maths/science, digital skills and citizenship, lifelong learning and mobility, teachers, VET and higher education.
Agrees nine EU-level targets for 2030, e.g. under 15% low achievers and 60% adult learning participation.
Calls for AI literacy and ethical, responsible use of AI in education and teacher training.
Keeps the existing governance structure (High Level Group, open method of coordination, peer learning).
Invites Commission to publish a final report in 2030 and propose a framework for the following decade.
annotation.summary_en: Council Resolution setting the second cycle (2026-2030) of the EU strategic framework for education and training. It defines six priorities, nine EU-level targets and governance via voluntary cooperation. AI appears only as a digital-skills and ethical-use topic in education; no robotics content.
